cases.title: a single-line block comment does not

export function main() { return 1; }

cases.title: comments do not affect the parsed signature

given.source: /* export function main(a: Date) {} */ export function main(b: number) { return b; }

cases.title: a string holding a declaration does not affect the signature, but a line of it starting with import does affect the scan
// lines are skipped inside an import block and as export lines
decorators and auto-accessors parse, as Bun bundles them
cases.note: The parse accepts TypeScript's decorators (class, member and parameter) and auto-accessors; the reference does not say which syntax Windmill's parser accepts.

cases.title: the deprecated import … assert {} form does not parse
cases.note: Babel 8 has dropped it; ADR 0001 §5a lists the refusal.

given.source:
import data from "./data.json" assert { type: "json" };
export function main() { return data; }
